gloss: early evening, early part of the night

definitions.gloss: early evening, early part of the night
definitions.explanation: The period shortly after sunset when the night has just begun, typically around 7-9 PM.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{宵|よい}の{口|くち}だ。
{宵|よい}の{口|くち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: We started drinking from early evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宵|よい}の{口|くち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しくて→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Early summer evenings are cool and pleasant.

notes:
The early part of the evening, roughly 7-9 PM. Suggests the night has just begun and there is plenty of time ahead.

USAGE:
Often used in social contexts — especially drinking — to imply "the night is still young." The phrase ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{宵|よい}の{口|くち}だ means "it's still early in the evening" (so let's keep going).

FORMS:
⟦{宵|よい}→宵：27202_yoi⟧ (evening, literary) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (opening, beginning). Literally: "the mouth/opening of the evening."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{宵|よい}→宵：27202_yoi⟧: evening (literary, poetic)
- ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧: early evening (more neutral, around sunset)
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: night (general term)
- ⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧: midnight, dead of night
